11102431.originalText:
i followed up with every open lead this morning and caught the problem on the third message

every single one was written in lowercase

on x that read as a voice because half the timeline wrote that way

in the inbox of a business owner who ran payroll every month it read as a twenty year old who could not be bothered to hit shift

axiom 7 contextual inference: relevant unstated information may be inferred from available context according to ordinary human reasoning

the prospect had one message from me and zero history

so that message was the entire context available to them

so anything they wanted to know about how i would handle their deadlines had to be inferred from that one message with the missing capital letters included

the axiom gave them full permission to close that gap on their own

visitors ran the EXACT same chain on every website i audited this year

a copyright footer stuck on an old year told them the owner stopped checking

and once they believed that the generic gmail on the contact page read as a side project run out of a bedroom

they never emailed to confirm either guess

i rewrote the follow ups with capitals before lunch

this post stayed lowercase because x ran a different inference

the answer was experience by einaudi

by the time both were gone the three seconds were too

the owner paid for that widget because a sales guy promised it would capture leads

all it ever captured was the attention his headline NEEDED

they found out i was working forty hours a week and studying thirteen on top of that including saturdays

11102435.originalText:
did 200 real pushups tonight on a day i had zero motivation to train

walked down to the basement already tired and the dumbbell plan sounded miserable

motivation was the internal response that created the desire to take an action

that response was missing for the dumbbells

so i swapped the plan for one i could start right there on the floor

put on linda elys and did sets of twenty or thirty with the music loud and rapped along in the breaks

a song of hers with barely 270k plays came on around rep 130 and i realized i was enjoying it

the desire showed up AFTER the action started

everyone i knew waited for that internal response before they moved

and tonight the response that created the desire only showed up once i was already moving

and since pushups worked anywhere vacation lost its spot as an excuse

the dumbbells could have tomorrow

11121242.originalText:
i made my bed this morning for the first time in weeks

the only thing that changed was the blanket

my weighted one weighs six kilos and dragging it flat across the mattress takes two hands and a fight so it stayed balled up at the foot of the bed every single morning

last night i slept under a thin orange couch blanket instead

this morning i flicked it over the pillow with one hand in about two seconds and it looked good enough that i stopped and stared at it for a second

same guy and same bed and the same lazy morning brain

the effort dropped from six kilos to almost zero and the behavior flipped on its own

visitors on your website run on that exact math

a contact form with eleven fields is the weighted blanket

they saw phone number and company size and budget range and a message box that wanted a whole paragraph and they closed the tab before clicking into the first field

then the owner decided nobody wanted the service

the demand was sitting there the whole time and the form was too HEAVY to lift

cut it to name and email and one line about the job

11121243.originalText:
four ravens tried to knock a buzzard out of the sky this afternoon

i was standing in the kitchen watching it circle when they came in from the left and hit it one after another

and watching it i realized the whole fight was a live demo of something i wrote down as an axiom this week

axiom 1 emotion direction: every emotion is an internal response that directs energy toward or away from a target and the target and direction are what give the emotion its name

the ravens threw every bit of their energy straight AT the buzzard

meanwhile the buzzard folded its wings and dropped behind the rooftops with all of its energy going away from them

same sky and the same thirty seconds and two completely different emotions running on each side

the axiom put every emotion inside the one responding so the event itself carried zero emotion

the emotion lived entirely in which way each animal was moving relative to the other

the axiom said every emotion so it covered people the exact same way

hand two guys the same harsh comment and one of them walks straight back into the conversation to argue the point while the other one stops replying for a week

the comment was identical and the direction split them

so when someone says a situation made them angry the situation is the wrong place to look

find the target and find which way the energy went

find me one emotion with no target and no direction and the axiom breaks

nobody has found one yet

11121244.originalText:
my own journal app was a few days away from refusing to load

it pulled every single entry i ever wrote every time i opened it

233 days and over fifteen thousand entries came down in one shot and added up to 4480kb

vercel cuts you off at 4500kb

so i rebuilt it to send only the last month and load older stuff when i scroll back to it and search runs on the server now so it still finds everything

the page opened instantly after that and the loading screen i stared at every morning for months disappeared

and the weird part is i never noticed how slow it was until it was gone

i got used to the wait because i was the only person using it and i HAD to use it

your visitors are the opposite on both counts

they owe you nothing and they have three other tabs open

most slow websites are slow for the same reason my app was

the owner shoved every photo and every video and the whole portfolio onto the homepage at original size because more looked like more

a stranger on a phone with two bars got a white screen for four seconds and went back to google

you got used to your own loading time

nobody else ever agreed to

11121247.originalText:
chatgpt refused to believe ITSELF today

i was wiring my journal up so i could tell it to analyze my week and it would go read everything on its own

it built the link perfectly with the right dates and everything and then flat out refused to open it

turns out it only opens links a human actually pasted in because a made up url could leak data somewhere

so i flipped it around and let my server work out the dates and hand me fixed links that i paste myself

the url chatgpt wrote got rejected and the exact same url pasted by me opened in a second

the only thing that changed was who said it

your website runs into that exact rule with every stranger who lands on it

the line that says we deliver results is a link you built yourself and every visitor refuses to click it

a screenshot of a client texting you that the phone rang nine times the week after launch is a link someone else pasted

same claim and the visitor opens it instantly because it came from outside you

most homepages are ninety percent self written links

11158389.originalText:
a coworker texted me a formal letter in perfect bureaucratic german tonight to ask if i wanted döner for lunch tomorrow

it closed with yours most respectfully and a postscript solemnly swearing that his desire for the kebab was sincere

i laughed for a solid minute and wrote back in the exact same voice

it worked because both of us knew it was a bit

then i remembered that most business websites i open are written in that same voice

we are delighted to provide comprehensive solutions tailored to your individual requirements

except nobody is JOKING

a guy with water dripping through his ceiling at 11pm reads that and still has zero idea whether this plumber can come tonight

formal language is what people write when they have nothing concrete to say

it puts a suit and tie on a sentence with nothing inside it

the plumber whose first line says burst pipe and i am there within the hour gets the call

the other one gets a very polite paragraph and a closed tab

at least my coworker got me to show up at the office
